author: Inside Edition
description: These WWII bombs and relics were discovered in unusual places. In 2020, a WWII bomb exploded underwater as the Polish Navy tried to defuse it. In 2023, history enthusiast Adrian Dawson found several prizes in his Tasmania home, including one very special bracelet. In 2016, two strangers were brought together because of a military jacket from WWII. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: World War II Bombs And Relics Discovered
